1.name: Part I
1.ov: After decades without a championship, a new owner and an up-and-coming GM set out to return the Red Sox to glory. But reversing the curse won't be easy.

1.name: Part II
1.ov: Injuries and a failed trade for a powerhouse shortstop lead to a rocky 2004 season. But the momentum begins to shift during a series against the Yankees.

1.name: Part III
1.ov: Down 3-0 to the Yankees in the ALCS, the Sox launch an epic comeback. A steal, an unwavering pitcher and a Papi homer pave the way to the World Series.
